facts.fact: leFaso.net reports that the BCEAO, which sets the connection deadlines for banks, e-money and payment institutions and microfinance, launched the PI-SPI interoperable instant payment platform on 30 September 2025, with 80 institutions connected by 24 June 2026.
leFaso.net reports that PI-SPI is a BCEAO instant payment platform across the UEMOA, in service since 30 September 2025.
